answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation non-portable across keys. A new operator may wander through cheap identities, but settlement weight only enters through one narrow inlet: a bonded sponsor plus a rotating miner panel must countersign a single, non-transferable work history, then lock slashable collateral as the anchor. If reused keys are proven, that stake is burned and the history is void. Unanchored identities get no grading seat and no share of the epoch pool, so flooding accounts cannot multiply rewards.
